description: Create a mail folder: at the top level of the mailbox by default, or inside `parent`. Nothing reaches anyone else and an empty folder is easily deleted, so this does not ask for confirmation. Point rules or moves at the returned Id. If Outlook does not answer in time, the connection drops, or a server error (5xx) comes back after the request was sent, the result has status "unknown": the write may well have gone through, so check before retrying — never resend blindly.

parent.description: Folder id or well-known name (e.g. "inbox") to create it inside. Omit for the top level.

name: outlook_create_folder
